summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Innovator Equity Dual Directional 5 Buffer ETF - Quarterly (DDSQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to make money in both positive and negative markets, on a limited basis, over a three-month period. The fund uses FLEX options based on the price return of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (ticker: SPY). DDSQ was launched on Dec 31, 2025 and is issued by Innovator.
